title: 第21章 买衣服第22章 纺织厂换布
content_zh:
小赵，你去称一斤糕点！一斤奶糖算我的，等会儿我来付钱！张昊宇摆摆手，唐大爷不用不用客气。
唐大爷笑眯眯的，这不是给你的，是给那俩小丫头的。小沙，你们刚才在吵啥呢？
沙武进把张昊宇想用鱼、野鸡野兔换热水瓶的事儿说了，又把大家说的话复述了一遍！
唐大爷看着张昊宇“小宇啊，你需要啥，直接来办公室找我就行！几个热水瓶又不是啥大事。”他接着说：“小朱啊，这点小事没必要麻烦你舅舅了！”
“唐老头，啥叫没必要麻烦我舅舅？我舅舅说了他们需要肉啊！公平交易咋就成麻烦了？又不是求他办事！”
唐主任气呼呼地“我还没到五十岁呢，咋就成老头了？你这是啥说话态度？我见到你舅舅，非得让他好好揍你一顿，一点礼貌都没有！”
张昊宇给每人发了一支中华烟，自己点上一支，“各位，继续吵哈！我看会儿热闹！”唐大爷乐了“你这小子，看热闹不嫌事大！”
张昊宇耸耸肩“闲着也是闲着！”
唐大爷问：“那你有多少鱼，多少野鸡野兔啊？”
“我一上午钓了四五十条三斤以上的鱼，被轧钢厂采购员当场拉走了！你们要多少，我晚上给你们送过来。
野鸡野兔各有十几只，你们要的话，我也一起送过来！也不知道你们吵个啥劲，又不是啥大事！”
“你这小子，站着说话不腰疼！你以为人人都有你这本事啊？想吃鱼可以自己去钓，还认识猎人，野味也不缺！你知道现在有多缺肉吗？”
“好多人几个月都没见过二两肉了！也不知道是啥原因引起的？这下半年突然就缺肉了，而且还缺得厉害！”
这会儿赵姨称好了糕点和奶糖，颠颠儿地跑过来递给唐主任，并没有直接递给张昊宇，这是懂规矩！要是直接递给张昊宇，那这算谁送的呢？
唐主任把糕点和奶糖，分别塞到两个小家伙手里，还念叨着：“拿着吧，这是唐大爷给你们的礼物！”两个小家伙却没有伸手去接，而是紧紧抱住哥哥的大腿，眼巴巴地看着哥哥！
张昊宇见状，赶忙说道：“拿着吧！谢谢唐大爷。”两个小家伙这才小心翼翼地接过来，奶声奶气地说道：“谢谢，大大爷，谢谢，大大爷！”唐大爷笑眯眯地说：“这两个小丫头可真招人喜欢！又可爱，又懂事，还特别有礼貌……”
“唐大爷，你们想要多少鱼啊？三到十斤的都有，你们随便选。”赵姨惊讶地问：“还能选啊？”张昊宇笑着点头“你们每个人要个一条两条，咱们这关系，当然可以选了！剩下的鱼就送厂里，他们可不在乎鱼的大小！”
唐主任突然想到，对了，轧钢厂给你多少钱一斤啊？”
“他们要的鱼多，所以给8毛钱一斤，你们要的少就按6毛钱一斤吧！”
赵姨连忙摆手“那可不行！我们不能占你的便宜，让我们选重量还给低价，这可说不过去啊！”

“赵姨，您别在意！几条鱼而已，都是我自己钓的！”
赵姨想了想“我们家人多，我要两条大鱼，野鸡野兔也各来两只。”白洁也附和道：“我跟赵姨一样！”沙武进说：“我要一条鱼，一只野兔一只野鸡。”朱霸杰说：“我各要两只，给我舅舅也带一份！”
唐大爷大手一挥，“小宇，你一样送十只过来吧！我也给亲戚们分一些！”
张昊宇满口答应：“好嘞，晚上给你们送过来！我也回家吃饭去了！”说着，他抱起两个小不点，准备打道回府。唐大爷赶紧喊道：“小宇，你先把热水瓶拿回去！”
“晚上送东西过来再拿热水瓶，不着急。”出了供销社，回到家时，母亲已经把饭菜做好了。看到两个小不点手里拿着东西，母亲好奇地问：“你又给他们买东西啦？”
content_en:
Xiao Zhao, go weigh a pound of cakes! The pound of toffee is mine, I'll pay for it later! Zhang Haoyu waved his hand, Uncle Tang, no need to be polite.
Uncle Tang smiled, this is not for you, but for those two little girls. Xiaosha, what were you arguing about just now?
Sha Wujin told Zhang Haoyu that he wanted to exchange fish, pheasants and hares for hot water bottles, and then repeated what everyone said!
Uncle Tang looked at Zhang Haoyu, "Xiaoyu, if you need anything, just come to me in the office! A few thermos bottles is not a big deal." He then said, "Xiaoyu, there is no need to trouble your uncle with this little thing!"
"Old man Tang, why do you mean there's no need to trouble my uncle? My uncle said they need meat! Why does fair trade become trouble? It's not like you're asking him to do something!"
Director Tang angrily said, "I'm not even fifty yet, so why am I an old man? What's your attitude? When I see your uncle, I have to let him beat you up. You have no manners at all!"
Zhang Haoyu gave everyone a Chinese cigarette and lit one himself, "Everyone, keep making noise! I'll watch the excitement later!" Uncle Tang was amused, "You kid, it's not a big deal to watch the fun!"
Zhang Haoyu shrugged, "Idle time is idle!"
Uncle Tang asked: "How many fish, how many pheasants and hares do you have?"
"I caught forty or fifty fish weighing more than three kilograms in the morning, but the steel rolling mill buyer took them away on the spot! How much do you want, I will deliver them to you in the evening.
There are more than a dozen pheasants and hares each. If you want them, I will send them too! I don’t know what you are arguing about, it’s not a big deal! "
"You kid, your back hurts when you stand and talk! Do you think everyone is as good as you? If you want to eat fish, you can go fishing yourself, you know the hunters, and there is no shortage of game! Do you know how short of meat it is now?"
"Many people haven't seen two ounces of meat for months! I don't know what caused it? In the second half of the year, they suddenly lacked meat, and the lack was severe!"
At this moment, Aunt Zhao weighed the cakes and toffees, and ran over and handed them to Director Tang instead of directly to Zhang Haoyu. This was because she knew the rules! If it was handed directly to Zhang Haoyu, then who gave it to him?
Director Tang put the cakes and toffee into the hands of the two little guys respectively, and said: "Take it, this is a gift from Uncle Tang to you!" However, the two little guys did not reach out to receive it, but hugged their brother's thigh tightly and looked at him eagerly!
Seeing this, Zhang Haoyu hurriedly said: "Take it! Thank you, Uncle Tang." The two little guys took it carefully and said in a sweet voice: "Thank you, uncle, thank you, uncle!" Uncle Tang said with a smile: "These two little girls are really cute! They are cute, sensible, and very polite..."
"Uncle Tang, how many fish do you want? There are three to ten kilograms of fish, you can choose whatever you want." Aunt Zhao asked in surprise: "Can I still choose?" Zhang Haoyu nodded with a smile, "Each of you wants one or two. With our relationship, of course you can choose! The remaining fish will be sent to the factory, they don't care about the size of the fish!"
Director Tang suddenly thought, by the way, how much does the steel rolling mill give you per pound? "
“They want a lot of fish, so they pay 80 cents a catty. If you want less fish, just pay 60 cents a catty! "
Aunt Zhao waved her hands quickly, "That's not okay! We can't take advantage of you. It's unreasonable to ask us to choose the weight and give you a low price! "
"Aunt Zhao, don't worry! Just a few fish, all caught by me myself! "
Aunt Zhao thought for a while, "We have a large family, I want two big fish, two pheasants and two rabbits each." Bai Jie also echoed: "I am the same as Aunt Zhao!" Sha Wujin said: "I want a fish, a hare and a pheasant." Zhu Bajie said, "I want two of each, and I'll take one for my uncle!" "
Uncle Tang waved his hand, "Xiaoyu, you can send ten of them here! I also share some with my relatives! "
Zhang Hao YumanHe promised: "Okay, I'll bring it to you tonight! I'm going home for dinner too!" As he said that, he picked up the two little ones and prepared to go home. Uncle Tang quickly shouted: "Xiaoyu, take the hot water bottle back first!"
"Bring the things over in the evening and then get the hot water bottle. Don't worry." After leaving the supply and marketing cooperative and returning home, my mother had already prepared the meal. Seeing the two little ones holding things in their hands, the mother asked curiously: "Did you buy them something again?"
